meta.name: Nerds 2.0.1 — A Brief History of The Internet
meta.description: Nerds 2.0.1: A Brief History of the Internetis a documentary series written and hosted by Mark Stephens under the pseudonym Robert X. Cringely as a sequel to Triumph of the Nerds. The series follows on by documenting the development of ARPANET, the Internet, the World Wide Web and the resulting dot-com bubble of the mid and late 1990s…
